# Optional first-boot network preferences and development recovery access.
# Normal setup needs NO card edits: connect HDMI and Ethernet, or use a USB
# keyboard for Wi-Fi. Open the URL/QR code on HDMI. First setup needs no password.
# The image initializes its factory-empty data automatically. Established,
# imported and unmarked data is never replaced or initialized automatically.
# HDMI picture/sound and standard USB keyboards are handled automatically.
# USB keyboards and supported GPIO infrared work together. Select the TV
# source/tuner and configure browser access through the browser interface.
# Only these seven keys are supported; obsolete/unknown keys are rejected.
# Never put real values in source/build inputs. Edit only the flashed card.
# Literal key=value, no shell expansion, quoting or inline comments.
hostname=satip-dev
# timezone=Europe/Berlin
# Optional SSH access, independent of browser access. Login username: root.
# SSH defaults off on a new card; supplying a password does not enable it.
# ssh_enabled=yes
# The Pi hashes a supplied root password internally. SSH and root-password
# recovery settings can also be changed through this file on later boots.
# root_password=your-root-password
# Optional WPA/WPA2 Personal Wi-Fi. Country, SSID and PSK go together.
# UTF-8 SSIDs and printable ASCII passwords; spaces in both are preserved.
# wifi_country=DE
# wifi_ssid=your-network
# wifi_psk=your-private-passphrase
# After successful first-boot import this file is automatically restored from
# the image template. Settings persist on data. This is not secure flash erasure.
